one: Computer vision from camera models to 3D reconstruction: geometry first, deep learning second.
pos: CS 231A is the classic course on 3D vision and geometry, complementing CS 231N: 231N leans recognition and deep learning, while 231A leans cameras, projection, stereo, SfM, and 3D understanding. It is more mathematical and geometric, and suits people interested in AR/VR, robotics, and autonomous-driving perception.
topics: **Cameras and projection**: pinhole model, intrinsics/extrinsics, distortion
**Segmentation and clustering**: classical and learned methods
**SfM and SLAM basics**: structure from motion
prereq: Linear algebra; basic probability and statistics; programming.
assess: Assignments plus a project, including geometric derivations and implementation. Check the current syllabus for details.
who: 3D vision, robotics, AR/VR, and autonomous-driving perception; CV students who want geometry foundations.
tips: Take CS 231N first or concurrently. Derive epipolar geometry and bundle adjustment by hand.
note: Not offered in the 2026–27 ExploreCourses listing.
